notes.title: Robbie in FRENCH?! MORE ACHIEVEMENTS?!! FIXES?!?!?
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/4e603c1051ae9c48fe0b6849eac826eca05aefce.png


With our first post launch release we are slowly yet steadily starting to translate our game to different languages! For no actual apparent reason Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries is now also available in FRENCH!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dMcg7S5ZtNg

Since we updated the game hellfire came our way, we also had to attend to Athens Games Festival and this year’s Websummit and so some fixes came later than expected…

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/1d77887de62f2c398a5f24ac7a8cf11a90619377.jpg



..BUT IT WAS FOR A GOOD CAUSE!! 



Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries WON the Semi Finals of the Nordic Game Discovery Contest in Greece and now we are going to the Grand Finals in Sweden !! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/f561a1dc44324a942a0ba3e8b173167214065718.png

( ͡☉ ͜ʖ ͡☉) WE HOPE WE MADE YOU PROUD ( ͡☉ ͜ʖ ͡☉)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/c1d1b3682794f1df0b5eb5763c99006fd08cc6a0.png

Back to the point - here is a list of issues that we fixed and new stuff that we added in the game apart from the French translation:


Achievement bugs fixed
+6 new Achievements
Various micro glitches
Situational bugs
Toned down the difficulty in some specific hell mode levels


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/660540b19f05dc891909307726eceb576efcd039.png

These are all issues we resolved because of your help, we couldn’t have made it without you <3 

If you’re reading this and you want to keep up or hang out with us out join the club on facebook  or Discord ( ͡~ ͜ʖ ͡°)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/7daad77478924cf1bcf2940fdcca4883acb894ed.png

We are also rapidly moving to port our game on Nintendo Switch! And PS4 !! And Xbox One !!! 

Thank you for reading this wall of text <3 
✧･ﾟ: *✧･ﾟ♡*( ͡˘̴ ͜ ʖ̫ ͡˘̴ )*♡･ﾟ✧*:･ﾟ✧

notes.title: ( ͡◉ ͜ʖ ͡◉) ROBBIE SWIFTHAND NOW ON FULL RELEASE!!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/1cae65eec55f93999ce6ce6231854cca95df498e.png

After 20 months of relentless development… After 1,9 metric tons of coffee... After close to two billion times we told our studio cats “please don’t do that thing you do with the wires”... After 130.000 global deaths... The day has come.

*QUEUE THE EXPLOSIONS*
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/44ce7e88b8834df136f4fe46ee273850f9837703.png


Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries… is now FULLY RELEASED ON STEAM!!11!!11! (NO CLICKBAIT)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4eRXan0PuRE

A sincere, sleep-deprived THANK YOU to everyone that has been with us since the early access version<3 The journey was long and arduous, but together WE PREVAILED!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/c2bcb8e3ecfad7321390077d0f7f3b351f85c3c8.png

Please enjoy the full Robbie-killing, wall-twisting, spike-sharp experience! 

For those that have yet to taste what a day (some hours at a time) in the life of Robbie Swifthand feels like, WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?!!?!!1?!?!?!!?!!11?!1?!1

For any feedback or questions please feel free to join our discord server here!

Even though we just released the game - that doesn't mean there is no room for improvement! We still want to add the following:

 More achievements to unlock!
 Trading Cards!
 Cloud Saves!
 Optimization and minor graphics setting (turn blood on/off, optional frame cap)
 AND MORE!!1!1!



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/7daad77478924cf1bcf2940fdcca4883acb894ed.png
AND NOW, WE CELEBRATE(or fall asleep on the couches)!!1!11!11!!!!1

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/660540b19f05dc891909307726eceb576efcd039.png

Thank you for reading this wall of text ( ͡☉ ͜ʖ ͡☉)

notes.title: ヽ(͡◕ ͜ʖ ͡◕)ﾉ GAMESCOM! DISCORD?!? RELEASE DATE??!?!?!ヽ(͡◕ ͜ʖ ͡◕)ﾉ
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/7e76338ec79adf9948181d2ed426d501b8ed499b.png

We hope you have been enjoying summer vacations since our last update! Summer is the time for relaxation, leisure and rest from work! In contrast we decided to focus and keeps ourselves busy preparing exciting stuff for you to enjoy once summer ends!

What do we mean by that? That the FULL RELEASE of Robbie Swifthand And the Orb of Mysteries is coming up at the 20th of September 2018!! 

WHO’S AS HYPED AS WE ARE ABOUT THIS?!!? 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/c2bcb8e3ecfad7321390077d0f7f3b351f85c3c8.png

With that being said we would like to invite everyone to give us their input for changes, fixes, pretty much anything you think would help us make the game perfect before the release!

For that purpose we created a secret club in our Discord Server 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/7daad77478924cf1bcf2940fdcca4883acb894ed.png

Here is how to get in our super secret feedback club:

1.Go to our discord server and click on the #secret_clubs channel
2.React with Robbie’s face on the post shown on the image
3.Now you’ll notice that “Pixel Reign Games” are available for you to join and post


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/0adf4a4878d1e3010cea6f0599dcdf3ca36a0a28.png

We are looking forward to talk with anyone interested!

We also wanted to share with you that this year we will be attending  Gamescom ! We’re super excited and proud for that achievement as well as thankful for you people for helping us throughout our journey to improve our game on a consistent basis <3

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/253a8c3d9d5baa6c24a3163fe3d437bdba40801e.png

If you happen to attend Gamescom this year please do come and say hi! We will be located at the Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.1 Booth A20 ) among other magnificent games made by great developers!  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b8bd34a379e0fb2c1996ed2820504f6aa3b6aa07.png

Thank you for reading this wall of text ヽ(͡◕ ͜ʖ ͡◕)ﾉ

notes.title: 🔥Final Major Area - RELEASED🔥
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/1cae65eec55f93999ce6ce6231854cca95df498e.png
 ANOTHER 26 LEVELS HAVE BEEN ADDED!	

We are thrilled to announce that  FINALLY the Third Temple Area of Robbie Swifthand is OUT! 

The new temple area is consisted of [spoiler] 20 levels 5 special levels as well as -of course- a bossfight. [/spoiler]

Took us around 90 days to complete  [strike] the upload cus the internet is slow [/strike] it but we could not be happier with it and we deeply hope you feel the same way. This one has been our personal favorite so far since robbie now has WINGS!! The wings will be available [spoiler] after finishing the second world and are obtainable the same way you obtained doublejump (͠≖ ͜ʖ͠≖) [/spoiler]

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/660540b19f05dc891909307726eceb576efcd039.png

We also released a new Trailer in case you missed it! Please have a look and let us know what you think! Your feedback is of GREAT importance to us! Go have a look and tell us right after you watch it! [spoiler] If you DO NOT like it we will blame our video editor, lock him in a room and force him to finish the HELL mode of Robbie Swifthand WITH all the secrets unlocked. If you DO like it, we will do the same thing but we will also put the video on Youtube (we would stream it but our internet is slow) [/spoiler]

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/f806b55bf9ef37cbbb108803c89dfd1d1beabb1e.png

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eghU4DA3lTA

 So what's NEXT ?!

 [spoiler]  The secret area and the final boss fight as well as some SUPER SECRET additions that we are not sharing in order for you not to miss out on the experience of finding out what we're going to add.. but we are very confident that you'll like what's coming if you like the game as it is ( ͡~ ͜ʖ ͡°)[/spoiler]

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/44ce7e88b8834df136f4fe46ee273850f9837703.png

 So what's NEW ?!

We tried to include as many improvements to the previously released content of the game as we[strike] forcibly	[/strike]  possibly could add to our Lead Developer's already stacked up schedule and somehow we managed to add the following in addition to the 26 new levels:


    Controls are now a tiny bit more precise and no more frame based! (EXCITING STUFF!1!!)
    Animation and visual bugs fixes
    Robbie has brand new refined textures + his hair moves which is nice
    We polished the environmental textures of the 1st temple area to be up to the standard of the rest of the game
    We added some decorations to the doors of the Main Hall


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b8bd34a379e0fb2c1996ed2820504f6aa3b6aa07.png

Thank you for reading this wall of text, we sincerely hope you stick around until our next and final Major Update - that will also be the FULL RELEASE of the game ( ͡◉ ͜ʖ ͡◉)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/1d2e7bf59652eb33a7335ff33c115db4664ad00b.png

notes.title: Another 26 brand new levels are FINALLY available in Robbie Swifthand!
notes.content:
With our first major update Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries DOUBLES in size - now containing 52 levels in total (both in Normal and HELL mode) with an area full of plants, now isn’t that an exciting way to enter the Spring season?  (◕‿◕✿) 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b0e0c75c4d96ee957ddcc0e09de26964b9c1ea68.png

 Area 2 Release Announcement Video

The ancient civilisation that built this place to be the garden of the temple. The tables have turned and the peaceful garden will be your graveyard if you make one wrong decision!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/0a132395b60383ea3b358f9a68539a74b6e21706.png

This Area appears to be different in every way compared to the previous one! Expect a whole new way to play as Robbie Swifthand since the levels of this area are significantly larger in size and more complicated in trickstery! HOWEVER FEAR NOT .. FRIEND .. as you will be provided with a great gift to help you overcome the challenges that lie ahead of you!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/c1d1b3682794f1df0b5eb5763c99006fd08cc6a0.png

There is a small part missing from this update but it will be added within the next 2 weeks so thank you for bearing with us until then : 

[spoiler]By the end of this world there is also some new hints about the story of this temple given by a new character that enters the game, and her story will unfold as you discover more and more secrets of the temple![/spoiler]
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b8bd34a379e0fb2c1996ed2820504f6aa3b6aa07.png
Notes :

You will now also notice that the following changes have been made with this update:

Robbie now has a probability of respawning with wounds from his most recent death!
Some levels in the first Area are now somewhat easier..
Added a main hall to the game so you can select the Area you would like to enter!
The tutorial of HELL mode is now easier (but it’s still HELL mode)
Polished the animations, controls and physics of the Robbie
Fixed some minor gameplay bugs reported by the community (thank you so much guys <3)


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/6cb370c5781d30522fe83e7db3d36c8bf63924a3.png
The area will be available to play for everyone that has successfully played through the first Area, for any bugs please contact us - we aim to resolve any potential issues at once!

We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed creating it yet please do let us know what you think regardless!

notes.title: Early February Update Notes and Upcoming Content
notes.content:
A new temple area is close to release in which EVERYTHING is different! Even a mysterious female character was added so who’s up for some news about what’s happening in the world of Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries?!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b0e0c75c4d96ee957ddcc0e09de26964b9c1ea68.png

Fellow reader we know that a month has passed since our previous post announcement (or millenia in Steam Early Access time equivalence ) so we hope to meet your expectations with this one!

For a starter we would like to mention that small changes have been made in the early stages of the first temple area so new players can have a little bit more time to get the mechanics of the game before the real challenge starts!

Alongside with that we also added a resolution change setting for users that experience lower framerates. 
(You can lower the resolution by accessing the setting in the menu as shown in the image below)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/f8104624d595dd0644ab2e5079456d4645705637.png

We would also like to announce that if everything goes as planned we will be able to release the second temple area by the end of February - all levels of Normal mode are ready for testing but there is a boss fight and a HELL mode (for lunatics like our Level Designer that enjoy the extra challenge) to craft ahead! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/c1d1b3682794f1df0b5eb5763c99006fd08cc6a0.png

We also have a commitment not to release anything un-polished or incomplete so bear with us for a few weeks ( ͡°ω ͡°) 

On the flip side we still have time to tweak some stuff so your feedback would be of great importance to us!

We have released video since the last post announcement so please let us know what you think of our progress:

 Robbie Swifthand - Area 2 Progress 2	

Any feedback is welcome - our aim is to craft a game that will be as good as we can make it so no sugarcoating, let us know what you think!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31261416/b8bd34a379e0fb2c1996ed2820504f6aa3b6aa07.png

If you would like to see more of our content check out our  facebook	,   instagram	 or  twitter	 where you can also follow us to be notified about our latest work.

Thank you for reading this wall of text and we hope you stick around for more ( ͡ʘ ͜ʖ ͡ʘ)
